svg.text: When each machine was taking work, 14 to 18 October 2026, UTC
A sample every minute from Wed 14 Oct 19:10 to Sun 18 Oct 19:09 UTC. Braket: ONLINE and inside an execution window. IonQ: available. IBM: operational and active.
Braket says ONLINE for a machine that is between windows and will not run anything, so the light blue is as closed as the red.
